recap.narration_text: Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: front. twenty. ahead. Look well ahead rather than focusing only on the area immediately in front of the vehicle. The guide recommends a visual lead of twenty to thirty seconds along the intended travel path. If a curve, hill or vehicle blocks the view ahead, reduce speed and prepare to adjust the travel path.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: rear. overlap. distance traveled. Adjust the interior rear-view mirror to frame the rear window and show traffic behind. The guide describes positioning side-mirror views to overlap the interior mirror’s rearward view. Perception distance is the distance traveled between seeing a hazard and recognizing it.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: three. whenever parking. park. The guide limits a three-point turnabout to a two-lane roadway where a U-turn will not fit and going around the block is unavailable. The guide recommends applying the parking brake whenever parking, on level ground as well as on hills. In an automatic vehicle, the parking brake supplements rather than replaces selecting park.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: bicycles. eighteen. Before. Watch for a door opening and for people or bicycles emerging between parked vehicles. The guide requires right-side wheels to be within eighteen inches of the right curb when parallel parked. Before leaving a parked vehicle unattended, shut off the engine, remove the key, lock the ignition and set the brake.
